links.outcome: Guardrail identification of out-of-scope queries and emergency escalation scenarios
links.effect: Safety guardrails identified 100% of 120 out-of-scope queries and 30 emergency escalation scenarios.
links.quote: Safety guardrails successfully identified 100% of out-of-scope and escalation scenarios.

links.outcome: Readability grade level of AI-generated patient-facing responses
links.effect: Readability was 11th-grade level (Flesch-Kincaid 46.34), above typical patient literacy targets.
links.quote: While fluency and semantic alignment were high (BERTScore F1 0.9013, ROUGE-1 0.8377), readability was 11th-grade level (Flesch-Kincaid 46.34).

links.outcome: Groundedness and faithfulness of RAG-generated outputs to verified knowledge base
links.effect: Context precision 0.951, recall 0.910, faithfulness 0.956, with 95.6% verification agreement.
links.quote: Groundedness evaluations demonstrated strong context precision (0.951), recall (0.910), and faithfulness (0.956), with 95.6% verification agreement.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid deterministic NLP intent classification combined with LLM generation

screen.reason: The study empirically tests safety guardrails for out-of-scope detection and emergency escalation rules alongside RAG grounding in a simulated patient post-op interaction setting.

primary.practice: safety guardrails for out-of-scope queries and emergency escalation
